title: The model holds whether Penrose and Hameroff or Tegmark is right

statements.text: Whether microtubules keep quantum physical entanglement long enough to compute lies outside quantum information biology, which describes mental information states independently of who wins the debate between Penrose and Hameroff and Tegmark.

sources.quote: QIB describes well processing of mental informational states, independently of who will be right: Penrose and Hameroff or Tegmark
